server_url.description: Default Bugzilla server URL (must include protocol and trailing slash)

api_key.description: Bugzilla API key for authentication (preferred over password)

password.description: Bugzilla password for authentication (fallback if API key unavailable)

product.description: Default Bugzilla product to search in (e.g., 'Debian')

component.description: Default Bugzilla component to search in

priority.description: Default bug priority filters (empty = no filter)

max_bugs.description: Maximum number of bugs to list in summary view

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for server connections

extra_options.description: List of additional server-specific options (key=value pairs not otherwise covered). Each item must contain 'key' and 'value'. See pybugz(5) for supported keys like 'ssl_verify', 'cookies', etc. (Note: not all keys are officially documented; only standard ones included). Example: [{'key': 'ssl_verify', 'value': 'false'}]. We keep this minimal per instructions — only if documented real settings exist, but pybugz(5) does not list arbitrary key=value. Hence this is unused in practice for standard configs and defaults to [] for safety.

servers.description: List of additional server configurations. Each entry represents an alternate Bugzilla instance with its own overrides.
